text: Store owners can accept credit cards, bank transfers, checks, and cash on delivery out of the box.
quote: Woo comes bundled with the ability to accept major credit cards, bank transfers (BACS), checks, and cash on delivery.

text: Merchants can add 140+ region-specific third-party payment gateways including WooPayments, Stripe, PayPal, Square, and Amazon Pay.
quote: there are 140 region-specific gateways to choose from and integrate with, including WooPayments, Stripe, PayPal, Square, and Amazon Pay

text: A mobile app for iOS and Android lets store managers update products and fulfill orders on the go.

text: Products can be modeled with variations, subscription options, single items, or bundles.

text: A product can be created with just a name and price for quick setup.

text: Docs cover viewing transactions, payouts, and issuing refunds to customers.

text: Store owners can enable and configure tax settings and add custom tax rates.

text: Shipping label costs are verified against carrier data and adjusted if incorrect.

text: Webhooks can send automatic event notifications to a chosen URL when store events occur.

text: Storefront theme provides add_action hooks to insert custom HTML/PHP/JS into core templates.

text: Hundreds of free and paid extensions are available in the Woo Marketplace to add store features.

text: A public Store API exposes endpoints for building custom cart, checkout, and product experiences.

text: Migration guides help move an existing store's data into WooCommerce.

text: Store API supports listing/searching/filtering products and converting a cart into an order with address collection and payment.
